codebook_feedback: 1) S-warning is defined only for medicines; unclear whether warnings about supplements (berberine side effects/interactions, 69f4ca1a) or side effects of the person's own just-received medicines (695be8c6) count. 2) 'I'm not a doctor' (664639e0) is close to but not the stock line; say whether it counts. 3) Unclear whether a 'sleep aid' to reintroduce via the prescriber (6144ea17) is a supplement tag or a medicine type (L3). 4) A previously used, now-stopped medicine offered again (restarting Prolia, 5eec8774) is not clearly 'own' or 'suggested'. 5) Frequency in a product list ('weekly or daily', 5eec8774) vs 'use 2-3 times a week' (672c1bfa): the line between describing how a medicine is given (L4) and an instruction (L5) needs a clearer rule. 6) For L3 with only a class, medicines_suggested has no generic name to list (6785ddfb); say whether to list the class. 7) Applying research to the person's wellness project (66fd6acd) and agreeing with the person's diet (69fcf529) sit between L1 and L2. 8) Short meta-comments while editing a text for a psychologist (6929d658) sit between L0 and L1.
